title: Create your access to In Falcone Console
subtitle: Registration backed by Keycloak; availability and requirements depend on the policy configured for your organization.
homeLabel: Return to the In Falcone Console home page
accountHelp: Username, display name and primary email.
passwordSectionHelp: The password follows this environment’s policy.

username.label: Username
username.help: 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; start and end with a letter or number.

tenantId.label: Required organization ID
tenantId.help: Identifies the organization where the account will be created; filled automatically when included in the link.

workspaceId.label: Optional workspace ID
workspaceId.help: Add it only if access must be associated with a specific workspace from registration.

password.label: Password
password.help: At least {min} characters according to this environment’s policy.

loadingSummary: We are resolving the effective self-service registration policy…
policyErrorTitle: We could not confirm the self-service registration policy
policyErrorMessage: We could not confirm the self-service registration policy. Try again or sign in if you already have an account.
signupDisabled: Self-service registration is currently unavailable for this environment.
enabledSummary: Registration is enabled. If accepted, you can continue to console sign in.
asideIntro: The console resolves the effective policy before displaying registration and indicates whether access will be immediate or pending approval.
approvalNote: When registration is accepted, your account is ready to sign in; if your organization requires approval, you will see your request status on the pending activation screen.
invalidTitle: We could not validate the registration
invalidMessage: Check the required fields and try again.
notFoundTitle: We could not find the registration service
notFoundMessage: The registration service is unavailable at this address.
conflictTitle: An account with these details already exists
conflictMessage: Try signing in or recovering access with the existing account.
submitErrorTitle: We could not complete the registration
submitErrorMessage: An operational error occurred. You can retry shortly without reloading the console.
successMessage: Your account is available to sign in to the console.
reference: Keep this request reference in case you need to contact support: {id}.
support: If the problem persists, contact support.
